summary: Pacific Airport Group (GAP) filed a Form 6-K announcing the initiation of a process to establish a FIBRA trust (FIBRA GAP), which would subscribe a minority equity interest in its 12 Mexican airport concessions to fund a 2026-2029 Master Development Program with ~Ps. 40.0 billion in investments. No terms (stake %, price, premium) or timeline were disclosed. The structure involves a trust issuing certificates to raise funds; GAP acts as the issuer initiating the process. There is no board recommendation or advisor named. What to watch: regulatory approvals and final terms of the FIBRA issuance. This is an early-stage financing initiative, not a standard special situation.
